{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently 0.3-0.7 too high during uptrends, requiring 0.4-0.6 point daily downward correction",
    "When sentiment is positive (0.33+), align forecast with true outcomes by shifting 0.3-0.5 points below model",
    "Sentiment turning negative (-0.33 to 0) indicates model lag, add 0.3-0.6 point buffer below forecast",
    "Mean reversion bias: when prices deviate 1+ from 10-period mean, reduce forecast by 0.3-0.6 from model",
    "Model under-forecasts during price declines by ~0.3-0.6 points relative to bullish sentiment",
    "When sentiment has been negative for 3+ consecutive readings, subtract 0.3-0.5 from forecasts",
    "Corrective offset varies with price volatility: 0.2-0.3 for low volatility, 0.4-0.6 for high volatility"
] }
